about: Regenerated, not edited: node scripts/regen-tunable-pins.js. scan is the scanner's version and scanHash the hash of tests/plugin/tunable-scan.js: a changed scanner needs a higher scan (a test refuses otherwise), and a higher scan than the base's needs literals equal to what the scanner counts now. constants only shrink and are never reset.

mechanics.exitCode:\\s*2\\b: the hook protocol's block exit code (exit 2 blocks the tool call)
mechanics.code:\\s*-326\\d\\d\\b: a JSON-RPC 2.0 error code (the MCP protocol)
mechanics.\\.(?:toFixed|toPrecision)\\(\\s*\\d+\\s: digits of a printed number (display precision), not a threshold
mechanics.\\.(?:padStart|padEnd)\\(\\s*\\d+\\s*,: the width of fixed-width text (formatting), not a threshold
mechanics.,\\s*null,\\s*\\d+\\s*\\): the indentation of printed JSON (JSON.stringify(x, null, 2))
mechanics.\\.toISOString\\(\\)\\.slice\\(\\s*(?:0\: the fixed field positions of an ISO-8601 timestamp (a day, a month, a time of day)
mechanics.\\w*(?:[Dd]ay|[Dd]ate|[Mm]onth|Time)\\.s: the month or day of a YYYY-MM-DD string (a fixed format), not a count of anything
mechanics.\\bprocess\\.exit\\(\\s*\\d+\\s*\\): a process exit code (the shell's protocol)
mechanics.\\.randomBytes\\(\\s*\\d+\\s*\\): the byte length of a random id, not a threshold
mechanics.\\bDate\\.UTC\\([^()]*\\): calendar fields of a date (year, month, day), not a threshold
mechanics.\\.charCodeAt\\(\\s*\\d+\\s*\\)|\\.asInt: a character index, a bit width or a buffer size in a protocol or wait primitive
mechanics.\\bargv\\.slice\\(\\s*2\\s*\\): node's argv layout (the first two entries are the runtime and the script)
mechanics.\\b(?:round|fmt)\\([^()]*,\\s*\\d\\s*\\): decimal places a number is rounded or printed to, not a threshold
